subject: Follow-up: Isolation & deployment preference for PayFlow (Dedicated vs VPC)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Morgan <kyle.morgan@payflow.ai>
Cc: Anita Desai <anita.desai@payflow.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: Isolation & deployment preference for PayFlow (Dedicated vs VPC)

Kyle / Anita — thanks for the time this morning. Quick recap and a couple of clarification questions so we can size the right option (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC).

Call recap (high level):
- Use case: transaction classification + PCI-adjacent metadata enrichment for merchant checkout flows (low-latency inference; <120ms p95 desired)
- Current constraint: legal requires strict tenant separation and limits on third-party network egress for PII-ish metadata
- Expected QPS: starting ~50 rps with steady growth to ~200 rps in 12 months

Key question for qualification: when you say "tenant separation and no third-party egress," do you require:
1) Full private control plane / no managed control-plane telemetry (i.e., Private deployment on your VPC or on-prem), OR
2) Dedicated capacity in our hosted offering with strict network egress controls (dedicated GPU pools, customer-managed VPC peering, and specific routing policies)?

What matters for our recommendation:
- Data residency and egress policy (is any payload allowed to leave your VPC? must all logs/audit be pushed to your KMS?)
- Who needs access to the model logs / traces inside Redwood (redwood SRE vs your ops team)
- Desired timeline and procurement constraints (e.g., must be in your cloud account or can we provision dedicated capacity in Redwood-managed infra?)

Next steps I propose:
- Kyle to confirm whether on-prem/VPC-required vs dedicated-hosted acceptable (answers to the three bullets above)
- If VPC-required: Anita to share the minimal network diagram (VPC peering, firewall rules) and expected egress IP range
- If dedicated-hosted acceptable: Laura (SE) to send a one-page design showing how we enforce tenant isolation and KMS integrations

Attaching a one-page summary of the security asks we discussed; Laura and I will prepare the dedicated vs private comparison diagram once you confirm which direction is preferred.

Thanks — Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Kyle Morgan <kyle.morgan@payflow.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Isolation & deployment preference for PayFlow (Dedicated vs VPC)

Thanks Jonas — good recap. A few clarifications:

1) Primary requirement: no customer data (transaction identifiers, card metadata beyond token) may transit through third-party-managed control planes in unencrypted form. For now we can tolerate a managed control plane only if:
   - All telemetry that contains identifiers is disabled by default and
   - Audit logs and raw traces are exported to our S3 in our account (we control KMS keys)
2) Short term we cannot do on-prem (budget + time). Long term (12–18mo) we may consider a private deployment if regulatory needs change.
3) Timeline: pilot in 6–8 weeks; procurement prefers a one-page SOC/controls summary for the pilot contract.

I will ask Anita to pull together a simple network diagram and our security checklist. For now, assume we want Dedicated-hosted as the primary path, but we need confirmation on the telemetry/export controls you mentioned.

—Kyle
Director of Engineering | PayFlow.ai

Appreciate the clarity Kyle — that helps a lot. Looping in Laura (solutions engineering) and Rachel (account lead) so we can respond with config + controls for Dedicated-hosted and indicate what would change if you transitioned to Private VPC later.

Laura / Rachel — summary of what PayFlow needs for the pilot:
- Dedicated-hosted deployment (preferred for timeline) but MUST have:
  * Telemetry redaction by default for any fields marked PII/identifiers
  * Option to export raw audit logs and traces to customer S3 with their KMS (we support cross-account S3 + envelope encryption)
  * Network egress only to customer-approved IP ranges; no unsolicited third-party egress to analytics vendors
- Pilot: 50–100 rps, target latency <120ms p95, pilot window: 6–8 weeks
- Procurement: short SOC/controls summary required for sign-off

Laura — can you prepare: (A) a one-page diagram that shows how Dedicated-hosted achieves tenant isolation (dedicated GPU pools, network controls, encrypted at rest with CMK option) and (B) a short note that outlines what additional guarantees we provide for Private VPC (control plane placement, on-prem options, HSM integrations, air-gapped configs). If you have a template for the SOC/controls summary we can drop in, send that too.

Rachel — I'll create the HubSpot deal and add the procurement timeline + reason codes.

Thanks all — I attached a rough network/options graphic and the initial MOU (payflow_mou_v0.1.pdf) for procurement to skim.

Jonas

Thanks — I drafted the one-page doc and a minimal diagram (see attached redwood-network-options-2026.png). High-level notes for the thread (to share with PayFlow):

1) Dedicated-hosted (recommended for pilot) — what we provide:
   - Physical tenant isolation: dedicated GPU pools and per-customer workload queues.
   - Network controls: VPC peering or static egress IP ranges + firewall allow lists. We can configure to only route outbound traffic to customer-specified IPs.
   - Telemetry & logs: default redaction for fields marked as identifiers. Raw logs/traces can be exported to your S3 (cross-account) and encrypted with your KMS.
   - Key management: support for customer-managed CMKs for data-at-rest encryption in the dedicated storage tier.

2) Private VPC / Private control plane — what changes:
   - Control plane sits in your account (or air-gapped on-prem) — no managed telemetry by Redwood unless explicitly enabled.
   - Additional compliance options: HSM-backed key storage, dedicated private peering, and direct interconnects.
   - Longer lead time (4–8 weeks procurement + infra work), higher baseline monthly commitment.

3) Next steps / deliverables:
   - Laura: finalized one-pager & simple SOC/controls checklist (attached: security-reqs-summary.docx)
   - Kyle / Anita: network diagram + list of IP ranges + confirmation of KMS setup for pilot
   - Jonas / Rachel: finalize pilot MOU and timeline; Rachel to open HubSpot deal and attach docs

If PayFlow confirms Dedicated-hosted with the export+KMS controls, our infra team can lock down the telemetry defaults and prepare an export bucket policy for their security team to review.

Laura Bennett
